prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 49.5 °C (59% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 54.2 °C (51% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 55.8 °C (44% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.71 s (5% above healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.76 s (within 1% of healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.23 l/min (51% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 819 W·min/l (114% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 29.1 % (50% below healthy). High power-to-flow ratio demonstrates extensive internal leakage across the pump chambers.
Accumulator: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 57.3 bar (23% above healthy). Pressure stability and surge dampening meet full design specifications.
